notes.title: Back in Development and Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and apologies for the long silence!

In short: I’ve restarted development on the game, and a playable demo will be available soon. I’ll also be updating the game’s page shortly and aim to keep you posted more frequently with development updates.

In more detail: A few years back, I had to put the game development on hold, and unfortunately, the project itself was lost. At one point, I even reached out to the Steam Support, asking them to take down the game’s page to prevent it from lingering abandoned. However, as it turned out, removing a game page isn't as easy as I thought!
Over the past few years, I’ve been considering restarting development, but I didn’t want to make any announcements until I had made solid progress. Fortunately, over the past few months, I’ve found the time to get back into it and have made significant progress.
